title: Key Account Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
 Present and inform the doctors, pharmacist and Hospitals about the company products in order to obtain the prescription in his/ her territory
   

  

* Visit Doctors, Pharmacists and Hospitals in order to inform on products according to the marketing strategy and with the frequency and number of impacts approved for each segment of doctor. Build up and maintain a relationship with these stakeholders. Assist to Scientific congresses determined by the company.
* Classification of doctors and other stakeholders of the area according to the segmentation and targeting criteria. Proposal of new doctors to add to the files, changes or removals. Track the prescription habits of the doctor, check his/her consideration of our products, ensure which is the prescription potential and his/her influence in other doctors.
* Inform in an accurate, updated and according to the company's strategy about our products: use of marketing material, clarification of doubts and concerns of doctors about the products, opposition to objections, advantages compared to the competency. Ensure that other departments complete this information to the doctor if necessary.
* Obtain information from the market about the doctors' concerns on our products, the competence and test our own marketing strategy and materials. Obtain information about possible public tenders, launchment of competence products, cost containment measures, Health authorities possible instructions to doctors… Transmit this information.
* Propose activities in their territory (invitation to congresses, participation of doctors as lecturers, organization of clinical sessions…) that helps to promote our products always in compliance with ethics standards and ensuring the Return on Investment. Organize the proposals approved according to the budget assigned.
* Manage the budget assigned ensuring the return of investment
* Inform timely and in manner about the daily activity and the next weeks planification and present on time expenses report or any other requested by the company.
* University degree or equivalent is preferred
* Background in Science, biology, medical and pharmacy is preferred
* Proficiency in computer skill
* Good communication skill


**Location:** 
 Ferring India M\&S

title: Service Adoption Engagement and Deployment Lead
Servicenow-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service Now Associate Director**
**Education Level**
* High School Diploma/GED, Technical Diploma, Associate’s Degree/College Diploma, Non\-Degree Program, Bachelor’s Degree, Master’s Degree, Doctorate Degree, Higher Degree, Other
* Bachelor’s or Masters


**Job Purpose**
 The incumbent should be able to lead a group in Service Now Practice and provide directions and strategies to growing the firm’s Service Now footprint managing large and complex Service Now implementation, product development and sales enablement. This is a global role and candidate should have experience in working with large global teams spread across multiple geographies
   

  

**Responsibilities, Qualifications, Certifications \- External**
**Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)**
**Technical Skills Requirements**
* Lead sales and pre\-sales work in Service Now, respond to client proposals, participate in orals and help growing Service Now business
* Should have in\-depth knowledge and understanding of Service Now Partner ecosystem, licensing model and platform management models.
* Capable in designing and developing large solutions combining Service Now platform, automation and workflow capabilities for EY cusotmers
* Lead offshore team in all the Service Now modules like ITSM, ITOM, ITBM, HRSD, Sec Ops. The role will spread across blueprint, design, configuration, build and roll out phase.
* The role involves knowledge and experience of both functional and technical aspect for a successful implementation, working closely with various stakeholders like business, process leads and offshore team.
* Propose and deliver projects as per the agreed objectives to EY customers and/or to internal EY stakeholders
* Build strong internal relationships within the firm and with other services across the organization
* Develop people through effectively supervising, coaching, and mentoring staff. Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff
* Contribute to people\-related initiatives including recruiting, retaining and training.
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills of all staff
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of pre sales and practice development. for example, pre sales, internal engagement and / or knowledge management
* 15 to 20 years of relevant experience, preferably from a top tier Global System Integrator


**Additional Skills Requirements**
* At least two Service Now Implementation Certifications
* ITIL Intermediate, COBIT and or TOGAF certifications
* Agile and scrum master certifications
* PMP certification


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
